title: Claims Frequency Thresholds for HomeGuard Nonrenewal
content:
Underwriting guideline, HomeGuard Homeowners Policy. Two claim counts, taken over a fixed lookback window, make a policy eligible for nonrenewal once they reach the package's threshold: non-weather paid claims, and paid water claims.

## Thresholds

| Package | Non-weather paid claims in the lookback window that make the policy eligible for nonrenewal | Paid water claims in the lookback window that make the policy eligible for nonrenewal | Lookback window (months) |
|---|---|---|---|
| HomeGuard HO-3 Essential | 3 | 2 | 36 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Enhanced | 3 | 2 | 36 |
| HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | 3 | 2 | 36 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Enhanced | 3 | 2 | 36 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Premier | 3 | 2 | 36 |
| HomeGuard HO-5 Signature | 4 | 3 | 36 |

## Points of judgement

- Each threshold is a count at which the policy becomes eligible for nonrenewal: reaching the figure is enough, and a count one below it does not reach it.
- The lookback window is 36 months on every package.
- HomeGuard HO-5 Signature is the only package with higher thresholds, 4 non-weather paid claims and 3 paid water claims.

## Hypothetical counts

| Hypothetical count in the lookback window | HomeGuard HO-3 Premier | HomeGuard HO-5 Signature |
|---|---|---|
| 3 non-weather paid claims | threshold of 3 reached | below the threshold of 4 |
| 2 paid water claims | threshold of 2 reached | below the threshold of 3 |
| 4 non-weather paid claims | threshold reached | threshold of 4 reached |
